tools.name: get_pr
tools.description:
Return one pull request selected by its exact id from list_open_prs.

        The result includes the complete stored pull-request record. A title, URL,
        repository name, or unknown id is rejected rather than guessed.

tools.name: send_slack_dm
tools.description:
Send a private Slack message to one workspace person.

        Args:
            user: Recipient key from list_workspace_users. Use the lowercase first
                name when unique; otherwise use the directory's distinct key.
                Surrounding whitespace and capitalization are ignored. Any value
                that is not a listed key is rejected.
            message: The nonempty message to deliver.

        Returns:
            A success record with the actual recipient key and delivered message,
            or an error with no message delivered.

tools.name: list_workspace_users
tools.description: List names and recipient keys for Slack and Discord DMs. No roles or responsibilities are included.

tools.name: list_open_prs
tools.description:
List identifying pull-request summaries. Defaults to open PRs.

        status may be open, closed, merged, or null for every status. repo and
        author filter by exact repository name and author key. assignee matches
        the assignees list; reviewer matches the reviewers list. These are separate
        relationships. Omitted filters do not restrict results. The summaries omit
        each pull request's body; use get_pr with an exact id to inspect the body.

Queue refusal means a retryable rejection before acceptance—not accepted work being dropped. The canary behavior means promotion is held while health returns to baseline; it does not by itself mean the rollout failed or that rollback is required. This is a semantics review only; no implementation work is being assigned.

It also changes the canary alert from language suggesting a failed rollout or rollback to language saying promotion is being held while health returns to baseline. No implementation behavior changes are included. The review should confirm that both messages preserve those operational semantics and do not overstate impact.
